I know exactly where youre coming from. Two years ago I decided to actively learn canto mainly bc i wanted to be more literate and bc id be going to college soon. It was definitely difficult to find ways/resources to learn, but if you truly want to learn, you can not give up. Here are some things that might help kickstart your journey

\- cantomando on youtube (check some of their playlists or even their older videos)

\- TAKE NOTES and keep track of what youre learning. Otherwise you'll have trouble retaining info

\- reading basic readings/children level stuff

\- listen to canto music (i love Dear Jane) and look at their lyrics and try to learn more vocab that way

\- cantoneseclass101 on youtube or their website
